verdict.rationale: Startup-ecosystem programs are a fair question for an immigration law firm that serves founders, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows founders listed among clients and general pricing (a 10% pay-in-full discount and a monthly payment plan); none of it documents YC or accelerator partnerships, VC-portfolio arrangements, or founder-community pricing.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider documents startup-ecosystem programs — YC or accelerator partnerships, VC-portfolio arrangements, or founder-community pricing
